summary: Allow check-in at the full stadium station on event nights
description: During the stadium concert series, the station nearby fills up early in the evening and turned-away riders end up dumping bikes on the sidewalk. Fleet wants check-ins allowed there even once the station shows full on event nights.

comments.author: sami.haddad
comments.body: We already have a lever for this. Flip overflow_parking on for that station and a bike can dock there even once it's showing full -- no new code needed for event nights.
